summary: Risk sentiment is defensive: Bitcoin and major crypto assets sold off amid roughly $550 million in long liquidations, while elevated Treasury yields and a firmer dollar pressured risk assets.[1][3] Oil remained elevated near $101 Brent and $89.6 WTI, with gold near $4,107; the available analyst commentary was insufficient to verify fresh same-day calls for most requested tokens.[1]
